description: This file defines the HarRecorder class responsible for recording HTTP Archive (HAR) data during browser sessions, including managing ZIP files, serializing HAR logs, and exporting artifacts.

classes.name: HarRecorder
classes.description: A class that records HAR entries during browser interactions, manages ZIP compression, and exports HAR artifacts.

methods.name: onEntryStarted
methods.description: Handles the start of a HAR entry, adding it to the entries list.

methods.name: onEntryFinished
methods.description: Placeholder for handling the completion of a HAR entry (currently does nothing).

methods.name: onContentBlob
methods.description: Adds a content blob to the ZIP file if it hasn't been added before.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Finalizes the HAR recording, writes the HAR log to file or ZIP archive.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports the HAR artifact after flushing.
